title: Choose the workspace composition
question: All three use the Corridor Command Map system. Choose the layout to carry into the build.

options.label: Case Ledger + Workspace
options.lineage: persistent run ledger, route progress, focused result tabs
options.thesis: Keep every inspection visible while one case receives a calm, spacious technical workspace.
options.viewport: A dark run ledger anchors the left; the selected case owns a route header, result tabs, and a broad evidence workspace.
options.risk: The new-inspection form must open in a drawer or modal because intake is not permanently visible.

options.label: Intake + Evidence + Decision
options.lineage: top run line, permanent intake, three-column operations
options.thesis: Let operators create a new inspection while reading evidence and recommendations from the selected run.
options.viewport: A run line spans the top while intake, selected evidence, and decision output remain visible together.
options.risk: Permanent intake competes with the results and compresses long reports.

options.label: Dense Operations Matrix
options.lineage: run table, workflow route, case inspector, intake drawer
options.thesis: Expose queue health, detailed evidence, worker state, review status, and intake in one desktop view.
options.viewport: A run table, central case workspace, inspector pane, and slide-over intake form share one dense operations screen.
options.risk: The four-column layout is powerful on wide displays but visually crowded at ordinary laptop widths.
